tasks.corrected_reference_answer: A source-aligned design is to keep a small public theme API and map state-backed color/variant values to data attributes, with styling in CSS variables and selectors. AccordionComponent already puts color_scheme and variant into custom_attrs and excludes their original prop names (reflex/components/radix/primitives/accordion.py:52-71); selectors support inherited variants (lines29-49). Preserve the dependencies of these Vars through compilation and test runtime updates under memoization. Data attributes are still rendered attributes; their use does not by itself bypass React updates or prove memoization safety.

material_errors: Conflates Root test fixture with framework orchestrator, class registration with instance construction, and manager persistence with State event processing/broadcast.
tasks.notes: Read the question/reference and relevant pinned-source code; static review only, no repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: A root BaseState subclass anchors the state hierarchy. Subclass definition registers each child class in its parent’s class_subclasses (reflex/state.py:512-520), while instance initialization optionally constructs substate instances and links their parent_state (lines418-424). These are distinct registration and construction stages. State managers provide storage/access policies; this does not mean a class named Root itself broadcasts updates or that StateManager owns BaseState event processing. The supplied answer overassigns those responsibilities and cannot establish them from root inheritance alone.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: AppHarnessProd exports frontend files and serves them through Subdir404TCPServer with SimpleHTTPRequestHandlerCustomErrors, separately from its multi-worker backend (reflex/testing.py:1029-1058). The server class inherits socketserver.TCPServer (lines991-1025). Adding backend workers does not directly add static-server request workers. Whether static-file response latency changes due to shared resource contention requires measurement; the source alone does not establish that it worsens or that a10MB response is I/O-bound.
